findings.summary: compareAndSwap awaits inner.commit before writing the authority bag; concurrent load/snapshot can observe advanced head without consume+receipt.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Permit-authorized CAS MUST never expose load()/snapshot() with advanced state/journal lacking matching consumed permit+receipt; add an interleaving/observable-atomicity test.

findings.summary: Exact-replay does not validate arguments_digest/other digests before returning the prior OperationReceipt.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Same permit/operation with different arguments MUST NOT short-circuit as exact replay; add negative test.

findings.summary: permit-reuse does not consult authority bag consumed status after findReplayReceipt misses.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Bag-consumed without matching receipt MUST fail closed with permit-reuse (including after restart with empty issued Map); add test.

findings.summary: Restart recovery tests only assert load() after snapshot→initial; public runKernelOperation exact-replay after restart is unverified.
findings.acceptance_criteria: After restart with empty issued ledger, runKernelOperation exact replay MUST return prior receipt without re-running effects; add test.
